styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent stage-light tech audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep indigo stage backdrop #4A4E9E, light lavender-white gradient cards #EEF0FA, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and violet accent #8B2FC9; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; backgrounds alternate between a deep indigo stage space with soft light beams and a clean white canvas with rounded gradient cards; stage spotlight lighting from above with soft glow and gentle contact shadows; thin-line rounded icons inside circular or square outline chips; rounded-rectangle info labels with generous padding; product centered with stable scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 6 片 800x1200 详情页切片提炼。品类按图判定：可折叠头戴式蓝牙耳机，与源文件夹名「耳机」一致，L1=手机数码/耳机音频；与库内已有 12 款耳机模版以「可折叠便携+舞台聚光深蓝紫视觉」区分。已剥离：型号字样、侧边疑似品牌拼写英文竖排字、模板站水印「千图出品」、「加入会员全店免费」二维码贴片、规格表中的假数据（尺寸与响应频率同值、佩戴方式标注与头戴形态不符、传输距离等）。源图设计错误已修正：功能图标墙原图重复两行，模版改为 2 行 3 列六个独立标签；细节棋盘原图图片位为灰色空位，模版改为折叠铰链/耳罩纹理/头梁连接三个具体细节镜头。所有文案均为脱敏 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽，未虚构任何认证、数据或功效承诺。
